report_notes: Apache 2.4.68 with mod_php uses 20 prefork processes and disabled keepalive; Workerman 5.2.2 uses 20 synchronous persistent Yii workers with Event 3.1.6. Both recycle after 10,000 requests/connections. These are a separate October 8 session using the same PHP 8.5.11, PostgreSQL 2,000-connection limit and load settings as the October 5 and 7 runs. Other runtimes were not rerun.

The Apache database ramp and Workerman ramps include socket read errors. Workerman closes persistent connections when recycling workers. Raw error counts are retained and reduce successful RPS using the same calculation as the existing runs; neither runtime logged PHP application errors during measurement.

smoke_commands: make bench-all RUNTIMES=apache-mod-php MODE=steady RATE=100 DURATION=20s THREADS=2 CONNECTIONS=8 OUTPUT_ROOT=/tmp/yii3-apache-smoke
make bench-all RUNTIMES=workerman MODE=steady RATE=1000 DURATION=20s THREADS=2 CONNECTIONS=8 OUTPUT_ROOT=/tmp/yii3-workerman-smoke
